canDo: Can describe a person or a place and get information with at least 5 questions.
review: Review the D1 present tense; add articles, adjective agreement and où/quand/comment/combien.
input: Listening: describing people/places; reading: short ads, flat listings or course descriptions.
output: Write a 70-word description; a 90-second spoken Q&A with at least 5 different question words.
checkpoint: Can keep gender and number broadly consistent in a description; asks questions without translating word for word from your own language.
challenge: Today’s challenge: on TV5MONDE Apprendre, find a short video presenting a French city (A2 level); write 4 sentences describing the city (watch the articles and adjective agreement), then 5 questions you’d like to ask a local, each with a different question word.

title: Describing, articles and asking questions
